name: Janssen Fast Filters for WooCommerce
author: christianjc98

sections.description:
Janssen Fast Filters adds a fast, lightweight product filter to your WooCommerce shop. Shoppers filter by category, attribute, and price and see results instantly, without page reloads.

It’s a block-based alternative to the default WooCommerce layered navigation, built for speed: optimized queries, a server-rendered first page, no frameworks, and no extra dependencies.

Filtering

  • AJAX filtering with no page reloads
  • Category filter with a collapsible hierarchy, loaded in a single query
  • Product attribute filters for color, size, or any custom attribute
  • Price range slider with min and max inputs
  • AND logic (match all) or OR logic (match any) for options within a filter, set per block; different filters always combine
  • Auto-apply, or an Apply button if you prefer
  • Sort by default order, popularity, rating, latest, or price
  • Pagination
  • Active filter tags with one-click removal
  • Categories and attribute options with no products are hidden automatically

Layouts

  • Sidebar: classic filter column next to the products that stays in view on desktop
  • Top bar: compact dropdowns above the products
  • Modal: filters open in a panel from a button
  • Mobile slide-in panel with touch-friendly controls on every layout
  • Choose which categories and attributes each block shows, and the order of the attributes
  • Add several filter blocks to one page; each keeps its own filters and URL key

Shareable URLs and SEO

  • Filters, sorting, and page are kept in the URL, so Back, reload, and shared links show the same products
  • The first page of products is rendered on the server, so it appears without waiting for a request
  • Works without JavaScript: filters, sorting, and pagination fall back to a regular form and links
  • Safe behind page caches and CDNs: visitor pages contain no expiring security token
  • Filtered and sorted URLs are served as noindex, follow, so search engines don’t index endless filter combinations

Accessible

  • Keyboard navigation and ARIA labels
  • Focus moves into the filter panel and back out, and Escape closes it
  • Page scrolling is locked and restored correctly

For developers

  • Versioned PHP and JavaScript extension hooks and lifecycle events
  • Renderer hooks for custom product cards (custom renderers register through Pro)
  • Catalog change events and a purge action for hosting caches
  • Opt-in performance metrics with wp janssenff metrics and Server-Timing headers
  • Fully translatable

Janssen Fast Filters Pro

Everything above is free and stays free. Janssen Fast Filters Pro is an optional add-on for stores that want more:

  • Products that match your theme. Filtered results use your theme’s own WooCommerce product template, so badges, buttons, and theme hooks look exactly like the rest of your shop.
  • Live product counts. Turn them on per block and every option shows how many products match the applied filters. Counts also work on catalogs with more than 10,000 products.
  • Filter presets. Save filter combinations, such as “Summer sale – size M”, as one-click buttons for your shoppers.
  • Sticky top bar and sticky controls. Keep the top bar in view while shoppers scroll, turn the sticky sidebar on or off, and set an offset for fixed headers.
  • Style customizer. Set brand colors, corner radius, button style (rounded, square, or text-only), and option style (checkboxes or pill buttons) for attribute filters.
  • Query caching. Product results and counts are cached and refreshed only when a change affects them. Orders and stock updates that don’t change availability keep the cache warm.
  • Performance dashboard. After you turn on metrics, see request counts, cache hit ratios, and response times.
  • Skeleton loaders. Placeholder product cards in your grid’s layout while results load.
  • Top bar extras. The dropdowns show how many options are selected and the chosen price range.

Free vs Pro

  • AJAX filtering by category, attribute, and price: Free and Pro
  • AND/OR logic, auto-apply, sorting, and pagination: Free and Pro
  • Sidebar, top bar, and modal layouts: Free and Pro
  • Multiple filter blocks per page: Free and Pro
  • Shareable URLs, server-rendered first page, works without JavaScript: Free and Pro
  • Page-cache and CDN safe, SEO-friendly filtered URLs: Free and Pro
  • Products rendered with your theme’s product cards: Pro
  • Live product counts: Pro
  • Filter presets: Pro
  • Sticky sidebar on desktop: Free and Pro
  • Sticky top bar, sticky on/off switch, and adjustable offset: Pro
  • Style customizer: Pro
  • Query and count caching: Pro
  • Performance dashboard: Pro
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New and search for “Janssen Fast Filters”.
  2. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Open your shop page or a product archive template in the block editor and add the “Product Filter” block.
  4. Choose a layout and the filters to show in the block settings.
sections.faq:
Which WooCommerce version do I need?

WooCommerce 7.0 or higher.

Does it reload the page?

No. Filtering, sorting, and pagination happen without a page reload. The first page of products is rendered on the server for a fast first view.

Can shoppers share or bookmark a filtered page?

Yes. Applied filters, sorting, and page are kept in the URL, so Back, reload, and shared links restore them. You can turn this off per block.

Which layouts are available?

Sidebar, top bar, and modal, all included in the free plugin. On mobile, filters open in a slide-in panel.

Does it support AND and OR logic?

Yes. Choose per block whether options selected within one filter match any of them (OR) or all of them (AND). Different filters, such as color and size, always combine.

Can I filter by custom attributes?

Yes. All registered WooCommerce product attributes are available, and you choose which ones each block shows and in what order.

Does it work with page caching and CDNs?

Yes. Visitor pages contain no expiring security token, so cached pages keep working. Filtered URLs are marked noindex so search engines don’t crawl every combination.

Does it work without JavaScript?

Yes. Filters, sorting, and pagination fall back to a regular form and links.

What does Pro add?

Pro renders results with your theme’s own product cards and adds live product counts, filter presets, a sticky top bar, a style customizer, query caching, and a performance dashboard. See “Janssen Fast Filters Pro” above.

Do I need Pro?

No. The free plugin is a complete product filter. Pro is for stores that want theme-matched product cards, counts, presets, and branding controls.
sections.changelog:
1.5.1

  • The block editor now allows more than one Product Filter block per post; each block keeps its own state, and the editor warns when two blocks share a URL key
  • The attribute order list in the block settings is labeled “Display order”, matching its move up and move down buttons
  • Rewrote the plugin description with an accurate feature list and a Free vs Pro comparison

1.5.0

  • Filters, sort, and page are kept in the URL, so Back, reload, and shared links restore them; each block has “Keep filters in the URL” and its own URL key
  • Blocks render their first page of products (and Pro counts) on the server, so the first view needs no request
  • Without JavaScript, filters, sort, and pagination work as a form and links in every layout
  • Cached pages keep working: visitors’ pages no longer embed an expiring REST nonce; public caching of product requests is opt-in
  • Filtered and sorted URLs are served with noindex, follow
  • Added catalog change events so caches and page caches invalidate only what a change affects, and a purge action for hosts
  • Live counts are computed in one SQL statement per filter group, so catalogs above 10,000 products get counts too
  • Added opt-in request metrics (wp janssenff metrics) and Server-Timing for store managers
  • A page past the last one now reports the real product total
  • Filter inputs are now named after URL parameters and use slugs; see the upgrade notice

1.4.0

  • Added a public facet-count operation that shares the product query’s category, attribute, price, archive, and AND/OR rules
  • Added optional count context on product requests and a query/cache policy that keeps third-party query changes safe
  • Added strict filter-selection validation for presets
  • Added per-block live count, sticky sidebar, sticky top bar, and sticky offset settings for compatible extensions
  • Improved the filter panel: focus moves in and out correctly, Escape closes it, page scrolling is restored, and double submits are prevented
  • Added the Phase 4 integration and migration guide

1.3.0

  • Added a public, versioned renderer context for per-block renderer selection
  • Added granular product and empty-state lifecycle events for renderer adapters
  • Kept renderer selection separate from product queries, filter state, and cache keys
  • Preserved deterministic Free cards when a renderer or adapter is unavailable
  • Added public integration documentation and runtime coverage for third-party renderers

1.2.0

  • Added a versioned product-render handoff for compatible extensions
  • Kept Free in control of requests, state, pagination, loading, and fallback cards
  • Preserved generic cards when Pro or a compatible theme renderer is unavailable
  • Kept cached responses free of stale extension or theme markup

1.1.1

  • Fixed duplicate DOM and bootstrap IDs when multiple filter blocks render on one page

1.1.0

  • Added canonical per-block frontend state with server-rendered bootstrap data
  • Added root-scoped lifecycle events, extension actions, and versioned PHP hooks
  • Preserved WooCommerce archive context throughout REST queries and cache keys
  • Isolated requests across multiple filter blocks and prevented stale responses from rendering
  • Fixed pagination controls submitting the filter form and resetting active filters
  • Retained compatibility shims for existing integrations

1.0.7

  • Fixed the no-results message remaining hidden after a successful zero-product AJAX response
  • Verified compatibility with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.0.1

1.0.6

  • AND filter logic and auto-apply are now fully available in the free version
  • Removed Presets UI from Free editor (visible only when Pro extension is active)
  • Fixed showPresets block attribute default to false
  • WordPress.org compliance improvements

1.0.5

  • Renamed plugin to Janssen Fast Filters for WooCommerce
  • Category hierarchy rendered as optimized accordion tree (single-query, N+1 free)
  • UX polish: improved spacing and animation refinements
  • Added Requires Plugins header for compliance

1.0.4

  • Renamed hooks to janssenff_* prefix for compliance

1.0.3

  • Trademark compliance updates

1.0.2

  • Improved loading and no-results states
  • Better mobile touch targets
  • Removed static term counts for cleaner UX
  • Code cleanup and compliance improvements

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • AJAX product filtering
  • Category, attribute, and price filters
  • Mobile-responsive design
  • Gutenberg block support

upgrade_notice.1.5.1: Allows more than one Product Filter block per post in the editor. No changes to existing blocks.
upgrade_notice.1.5.0: Keeps filters in the URL (on by default for every block) and renders the first page on the server. Custom code that selected filter inputs by name should use the data-janssenff-taxonomy and data-janssenff-term attributes. Purge cached filter pages once after upgrading.
upgrade_notice.1.4.0: Adds the Phase 4 count, cache-policy, and validation APIs and fixes filter panel focus and scrolling. Product cache entries are rebuilt automatically.
upgrade_notice.1.3.0: Adds the public renderer API while preserving Free-only behavior and existing Phase 2 integrations.
upgrade_notice.1.2.0: Adds the Phase 2 render contract while preserving Free-only behavior and deterministic fallbacks.
upgrade_notice.1.1.1: Fixes instance identity when multiple filter blocks are rendered on the same page.
upgrade_notice.1.1.0: Introduces versioned extension contracts and isolated per-block state while retaining compatibility shims for existing integrations. Recommended for Janssen Fast Filters Pro 1.1.0.
upgrade_notice.1.0.7: Fixes the zero-results state and confirms compatibility with WordPress 7.1.
upgrade_notice.1.0.6: Performance and compliance improvements. AND logic and auto-apply now fully available in the free version.
